sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: The 👁️ column-visibility menu lists Barcode as "Barcode" instead of "▌█Barcode". The menu named each column after its header's full text, which includes the barcode highlight button. It now uses the same clean column name as sorting and filtering, and a column name that contains a digit keeps it.
"Barcode" in ⚙️ Settings → "Default hidden columns per page type" now hides the Barcode column. The setting saved "Barcode" while the menu looked for "▌█Barcode", so it never applied.
"Choose current configuration" in the page-wide 👁️ menu now also applies to the Barcode column in every sub-table on multi-table pages. It was the one column the sub-table menus did not recognise.
Show/hide choices saved by earlier versions still apply: a Barcode column you hid stays hidden after the update.
